description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E (%) performance across three different LLaMA-2 models—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under four distinct conditions: no SFT, SFT on $D_0$, SFT on $D_0, D_1$, and SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$. The x-axis displays the model names, while the y-axis represents the CoLeG-E (%) score, ranging from 0 to 50 with a linear scale. Each model has four grouped bars, color-coded and patterned according to the legend: light blue with horizontal stripes for "no SFT", light orange with vertical stripes for "+ SFT on $D_0$", light purple with diagonal stripes for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$", and light red with solid fill for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$". For all models, the performance generally increases with the inclusion of SFT, with the highest scores observed for the largest model, LLaMA-2-70B, which achieves a CoLeG-E of approximately 50% with SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$. The smallest model, LLaMA-2-7B, shows the lowest performance, with a score of about 4% with no SFT and reaching approximately 30% with the full SFT. The bars are arranged in groups by model, with each group containing the four conditions in the order specified by the legend.
